text: A psalm of David. For remembrance.
I Lord, do not punish me in your anger;in your wrath do not chastise me! [AA]
Your arrows have sunk deep in me; [AB]your hand has come down upon me.
There is no wholesomeness in my flesh because of your anger;there is no health in my bones because of my sin. [AC]
My iniquities overwhelm me,a burden too heavy for me. [AD]
II Foul and festering are my soresbecause of my folly.
I am stooped and deeply bowed; [AE]every day I go about mourning.
My loins burn with fever;there is no wholesomeness in my flesh.
I am numb and utterly crushed;I wail with anguish of heart. [AF]
My Lord, my deepest yearning is before you;my groaning is not hidden from you.
My heart shudders, my strength forsakes me;the very light of my eyes has failed. [AG]
Friends and companions shun my disease;my neighbors stand far off.
Those who seek my life lay snares for me;they seek my misfortune, they speak of ruin;they plot treachery every day.
III But I am like the deaf, hearing nothing,like the mute, I do not open my mouth,
I am even like someone who does not hear,who has no answer ready.
Lord, it is for you that I wait;O Lord, my God, you respond. [AH]
For I have said that they would gloat over me,exult over me if I stumble.
IV I am very near to falling;my wounds are with me always.
I acknowledge my guiltand grieve over my sin. [AI]
My enemies live and grow strong,those who hate me grow numerous fraudulently,
Repaying me evil for good,accusing me for pursuing good. [AJ]
Do not forsake me, O Lord;my God, be not far from me! [AK]
Come quickly to help me, [AL]my Lord and my salvation!
